BiblicalUsage: Goliath is the Philistine champion from Gath who defied the armies of Israel. In 1 Samuel 17:4, the text says "named Goliath." The life behind the name is told on the Goliath People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Goliath matters because God knows His people by name, and Goliath is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
RelatedEvents: David and Goliath; David's Mighty Men and the Philistine Giants
